title: York man was held at gunpoint over incorrect Flock hit. Sheriff blames illegal tag cover

reports.title: York man was held at gunpoint over incorrect Flock hit. Sheriff blames illegal tag cover

summary: Steven Melvin, a 42-year-old motorist in York County, South Carolina, was reportedly held at gunpoint for more than five minutes after a Flock Safety license-plate reader misread the first letter of his plate and matched his BMW to a similar stolen vehicle. The sheriff’s office later said an illegal tinted plate cover caused the error and called the deputy’s actions reasonable. Flock said alerts should be independently verified before enforcement.
title_en: York man was held at gunpoint over incorrect Flock hit. Sheriff blames illegal tag cover
